heading_path: Information to Include in your Tender

content_blocks.text: This provides a list of documents that can be included in your tender.
heading_path: Information to Include in your Tender

content_blocks.text: For complex and higher value regulated procurements, you may find some of the guidance and tools in Route 3 to be of benefit, but you only need to follow Route 3 where the procurement exercise is above the GPA threshold value.
heading_path: Information to Include in your Tender

content_blocks.text: If You Use PCS-Tender
heading_path: Information to Include in your Tender
If You Use PCS-Tender

content_blocks.text: It is best practice to have all documentation created on PCS-Tender before preparing the Contract Notice and advertising the requirement.

If You Use Public Contracts Scotland (PCS)

content_blocks.text: If you decide to use the online SPD Module on Public Contracts Scotland (PCS) (the Module), the selection and exclusion criteria will need to be detailed in the SPD i.e. not in the Contract Notice.
heading_path: Information to Include in your Tender
If You Use PCS-Tender
If You Use Public Contracts Scotland (PCS)

content_blocks.text: The default exclusion criteria required for a process valued equal to or above the threshold is provided automatically in the Module. You should deselect any that are not legally required or relevant and proportionate to your procurement exercise.
heading_path: Information to Include in your Tender
If You Use PCS-Tender
If You Use Public Contracts Scotland (PCS)

content_blocks.text: You are required to choose the selection criteria relevant to your procurement exercise from the provided list in the Module. You should not disclose information provided by tenderers which has been designated as confidential. This could include, but is not limited to, technical or trade secrets and the confidential aspects of tenders.
heading_path: Information to Include in your Tender
If You Use PCS-Tender
If You Use Public Contracts Scotland (PCS)

content_blocks.text: You may wish to consider adding a requirement to ensure your Organisation’s confidential information is protected throughout the procurement process.
heading_path: Information to Include in your Tender
If You Use PCS-Tender
If You Use Public Contracts Scotland (PCS)

content_blocks.text: Consideration must also be given to Planning , Sustainable Procurement and Risk Management throughout this stage of the Journey.
